name: Fourteen-player human SFT to full-action PPO with native-clock TH13 survival reward
frozen: Common controller seed within physical host on original Normal credits; title-specific stocks; no automatic shooting/bombing or geometric control.
initialization: Fixed 3000-update, 14-player SFT with lowest six-player mean movement NLL of the two registered training budgets. Both original TH10 variants scored above the old corpus; neither established a Stage 2 gain.
reward: TH13 native script survival clock, same event terms; TH10/12 unchanged. These two titles lack verified per-action native script time in the shared camera batch.
test: Full original Normal credits. Same original executable and physical host inside each controller-seed pair. Eight training credits per title and twelve held pairs per title.
stage_measurement: Separate fresh TH10 0.02a original games, corrected qualified stage channel, same controller seeds/build/physical host within pair, native RNG independent. Historical original outcomes retained as unknown.
